purpose: Choose which online job advert category carries the demand signal for a Helix career family.
what_this_is_not: Not a claim that a career belongs to an advertising category, and never used to produce a vacancy count. It selects which published index to read.
limits: Advert categories are broad and commercially defined. Healthcare and Social care covers everything from consultant posts to care work, so the signal describes the hiring climate around a family rather than demand for one job title. Helix says so wherever the figure appears.
maintained_by: Helix editorial. Review when ONS changes the category list.

Pharma, Biotech R&D & Manufacturing.reason: Industrial R&D and manufacturing science posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.

Healthcare Science & Diagnostics.reason: Healthcare science posts are advertised through healthcare channels rather than general science ones.

Allied Health & Clinical Practice.reason: Registered allied health posts are advertised as healthcare.

Leadership, Education, Operations & Cons.reason: The family is defined by management and consulting responsibility.

Medicine & Dentistry.reason: Medical and dental posts are advertised as healthcare.

Medical Affairs, Commercial, Market Acce.reason: Medical affairs, market access and communications posts sit with commercial and communications advertising rather than with laboratory science.

Research & Academia.reason: Research posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.

Quality, Regulatory, Safety & Compliance.reason: Quality assurance and regulatory affairs are the QA half of the Scientific / QA category.

Digital Health, Data, Informatics & AI.reason: Health informatics and data posts are advertised as IT and software roles.

Nursing, Midwifery & Pharmacy.reason: Nursing, midwifery and pharmacy posts are advertised as healthcare.

Clinical Research & Trials.reason: Trial coordination, monitoring and management are advertised under Scientific / QA.

Medical Devices, MedTech & Engineering.reason: Device and biomedical engineering posts are advertised as engineering.

Public Health, Epidemiology & Health Pol.reason: Public health posts are advertised through healthcare and public sector channels.

Laboratory, Pathology & Technical Operat.reason: Laboratory and technical operations posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.

Environmental & One Health.reason: Environmental and veterinary public health science posts are advertised as scientific roles.

Cell & Gene Therapy, Omics & Advanced Bi.reason: Advanced biology and omics posts are advertised under Scientific / QA.
